ask: Does this test now check the right thing, so we can take it once CI passes?
problem: Tom is a translator and records on his phone. The admin makes him a Viewer. His phone must lose the Work tab but keep his recordings. The nightly check of this failed.
found: The check looked for recordings from the test setup, not Tom's own. A phone opened after a server snapshot never gets those. So the check failed only on some nights. The app itself was fine.
changed: Nothing in the app. The test now follows the story. Tom records, the admin makes him a Viewer, his phone drops Work, and his recording stays. Then Translator returns and Work comes back.
why: This tests what matters to Tom: a demotion must never erase his work. The sync change in pull request 364 did not cause it. I could not run the browser tests here, so CI must confirm.
touches: One test helper gained an optional set-up step. No other test changes.
